newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz non-life unit sees good 97 profit.
newsitem.headline: Allianz non-life unit sees good 97 profit.

text.p: Allianz Versicherungs AG, the German non-life unit of insurance group Allianz AG Holding, said on Monday it expected another good underwriting profit in 1997.

Management board chairman Reiner Hagemann said business in the first quarter and good price developments led him to expect another good result this year after an underwriting profit of 403 million marks ($233.4 million) in 1996.
The company also said in a statement that its sales fell 2.2 percent to 7.38 billion marks in the first quarter of 1997 due to price cuts in motor insurance and lower industrial business.
However claims fell by two percent in the period, as higher claims for storm and frost damage were offset by a fall in car insurance claims.

Investments rose by 2.66 billion marks to 30.5 billion and running returns on capital investments rose to 527 million marks from 435 million marks because earnings were received earlier in the season, Allianz said.
